description:
We are looking for a Senior Power BI Engineer

🗣 Language Proficiency: Intermediate

🧾 Employment type: Full time

🌍 Candidate Location: Georgia, Armenia, EU, Serbia

🕐 Working Time Zone: CET

🚀 Start: asap

👥 Customer Description:

A global mobility and urban services platform.

🧩 Project Description:

Develop and scale analytics reporting by gathering business requirements, preparing data, and building clear, user-friendly dashboards.

The role focuses on dashboard development, metric accuracy, and automation of recurring reporting processes.

⚙️ Project Phase:

Ongoing

🤝 Soft Skills:

• Strong communication skills and the ability to independently elicit and refine requirements with business stakeholders.

• Exceptional attention to detail, ownership, and a proactive approach to continuous improvement.

💡 Hard Skills / Must Have:

• Experience developing BI dashboards and analytical reporting solutions.

• Strong SQL skills: joins, aggregations, window functions, and query optimization.

• Experience building and maintaining dashboards in Google Data Studio / Looker Studio.

• Ability to translate business requirements into actionable reports and appropriate visualizations.

• Understanding of data modeling, analytical datasets, and data marts.

• Data quality validation, discrepancy investigation, and metric calculation analysis.

✨ Hard Skills / Nice to Have (Optional):

• BigQuery experience, including reporting data preparation and query optimization.

• dbt and ETL/ELT pipeline development experience.

• Apache Airflow, Python, and Git experience.

• Portfolio of dashboards with business context and personal contribution details.

📌 Responsibilities and Tasks:

• Develop and maintain dashboards and analytical reports.

• Gather requirements and define relevant metrics and dimensions.

• Write and optimize SQL queries for reporting and data preparation.

• Build analytical datasets and data marts with the Data Engineering team.

• Validate data accuracy, resolve discrepancies, and automate report refreshes.

• Improve dashboard usability, performance, and documentation.

📞 Interview stages:

• English check (15 minutes)

• internal technical interview (1-1,5 hour)

• client interview (1 hour)

• client interview – cultural fit (45 minutes)

What we offer

  • Model: B2B contract with Bonapolia - one contract, one monthly invoice

  • Rate: negotiated per candidate seniority and client budget

  • Payment: monthly invoice, paid on the same schedule the client pays us (30 days)

  • Contract written under your country's law

  • We handle the client-side paperwork: MSA, NDA, invoicing

🏢 About Bonapolia

Bonapolia is a family-owned IT staff augmentation team based in Lisbon. We build engineering teams for product companies and IT consultancies across Europe and the US.

More at bonapolia.com


📩 Ready to Join?
We look forward to receiving your application and welcoming you to our team!
